name: hbm_xp_buf_rptr_1014-col1-COMMIT
purpose: A3 HBM group A 10-14: rptr1-19de62865 GRT-0116 (91 horizontal markers, all y 90-108 at the N face, x 40-90; srcs ob_d + outhold nets; M2 72.8% / M3 73.5% used). CUT ARITHMETIC: image bit fl[i] with i mod 2048 >= 1024 fed ob_d[i mod 2048] (block-dot) AND ob_d[80 + i mod 1024] (BF16) 944 bits = ~101 um apart with index-ordered N pins: ~4 x 944 = 3,776 wires per mid vertical cut vs 3,728 horizontal tracks (1.01) + ~1,556 write-broadcast wires. FIX (RTL + pin file, 0 cycles): shared column muxes m_lo[r] = fl[r + 2048 s], m_hi[r] = fl[1024 + r + 2048 s] give every image bit ONE load; ob_d[r] / ob_d[1024 + r] / BF16 ob_d[80 + r] all read column r; N-face pin file interleaves ob_d[r], ob_d[1024 + r] (M3 / M5, PG-stripe aware) so the only horizontal read traffic is the 80-bit BF16 offset (~160 + 80 wraps a cut): ~1,800 / 3,728 = 0.48 with the writes. Outline unchanged 220.32 x 108; exact vs original ot_hgi_xp_buf + lane mutant.
